subject: Request: Temporary latency SLA amendment & remedy proposal
messages:
From: Sophie Lamar <sophie@serenityai.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-08-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Service levels for Q4 pilot - request

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We've run a short internal pilot and identified a steady 98.3% p50 latency under our workload but occasional spikes pushing p95 beyond our target of 600ms. We need a binding SLO for the upcoming Q4 pilot and would like to request a temporary latency SLA amendment for a six-week pilot window: p95 <= 650ms and a capped service-credit schedule if exceeded.

Attached is a short doc with sample traffic (Serenity_SLO_Request_v3.pdf).

Can you confirm whether Redwood can support this pilot SLO and what remedies you would propose if the pilot crosses thresholds? Our procurement team may also need a short contract amendment.

Best,
Sophie Lamar
Head of Platform
SerenityAI

From: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
To: Sophie Lamar <sophie@serenityai.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-08-21T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Service levels for Q4 pilot - request

Sophie —

Appreciate the details and the attachment. Short answer: yes, we can pilot a temporary SLO variant for six weeks. Proposed approach:

- Interim SLO: p95 <= 650ms for pilot window (six weeks)
- Remedies: tiered service credits starting at 2% monthly credit if p95 breaches 650–750ms; 5% if >750ms
- Provisional price concession: 10% discount on usage for pilot period to offset onboarding risk
- Operational guardrails: dedicated on-call, telemetry hooks, and a weekly sync

I've attached a working remedy spreadsheet that quantifies expected credits under sample breach profiles (Redwood_Remedy_Proposal_20260821.xlsx).

I'll loop in Deal Desk and Jon to secure exec clearance for the discount and nonstandard remedy.

Laura Bennett
Senior AM, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
To: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-08-21T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: Escalation: SerenityAI pilot SLO amendment + proposed commercial trade

Team —

Summary: SerenityAI (strategic AI startup, potential $450k ARR pilot) requests a six-week temporary latency SLA: p95 <= 650ms with a tiered credit/remedy schedule and a 10% usage discount for the pilot. They provided traffic samples; initial validation shows our runtime can meet this with tuning but there is operational risk during the first two weeks.

Request:
- Exec approval for a one-time 10% consumption discount for the pilot (six weeks)
- Approval for the proposed tiered service-credit schedule (2% / 5%) as the exclusive remedy for the pilot
- Authority to sign a short contract amendment with Serenity procurement with those terms

Rationale:
- High strategic upside; fast path to a larger Dedicated commitment if pilot succeeds
- Credits are capped and timeboxed; discount limited to the pilot window
- We will attach telemetry SLIs and automatic rollback to the standard model variant if instability detected

Impact on precedent: low — timeboxed, caps in place, requires Deal Desk and Finance signoff for accounting.

Attachments: Redwood_Remedy_Proposal_20260821.xlsx (breakdown and expected worst-case credit exposure = ~$7.2k)

Can you confirm approvals? If yes, I will coordinate legal + procurement and prepare the amendment.

Thanks,
Laura

From: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
To: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-08-24T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Escalation: SerenityAI pilot SLO amendment + proposed commercial trade

Laura —

Approved with conditions.

Conditions:
1) Discount capped to the pilot billing period and applied as a credit, not invoice reduction; Finance to review accounting treatment.
2) Service credits limited to the two-tier schedule you proposed; include a hard cap equal to 3% of expected pilot spend.
3) Legal to include a 30-day post-pilot performance review clause and an auto-revert to standard SLA if we observe repeated breaches during weeks 1–2.
4) Jon, please coordinate on-call coverage and confirm whether engineering can guarantee telemetry flags for auto-fallback.

Ben — loop in Finance to confirm the cap. Jonas — confirm operational readiness.

Marissa Cole
VP, Deal Desk
Redwood Inference
